mira: Kicking off launch-ramp sync for Marketplace go-live. Need clear owners for lanes: press, microsite, SI standby, docs, and support comms. Can we confirm owners + any hard blockers?
jon: I’ll own microsite + landing copy. Will deliver final hero + FAQ by Thu COB.
sam: Partnerships will own SI liaison + partner comms. @lee can you confirm SI oncall window and runbook needs?
lee: SI partner confirmed for launch day 08:00-18:00 PT. They need the cutover runbook by Fri morning and staging creds by Thu. Also want a 30m dry-run on Wed.
mira: Draft runbook snippet below — please review and flag gaps. I’ll iterate after comments.
```
Runbook v0.1
- 07:30 PT: pre-cutover health checks (microsite, auth, billing)
- 08:00 PT: traffic switch to catalog v1 (feature-flag rollout)
- 08:00-10:00 PT: press embargo lift window (PR on standby)
- 08:05 PT: confirm SI ingress and partner webhooks
- 08:10 PT: smoke test shopping flow + embedding calls
- Escalation: ops@redwood + lee@partner-sii + pr-oncall
```
partners-bot: FYI — embargo window already logged: 2026-03-26 08:00-10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to channel.
jon: :thumbsup: We’ll freeze content at Thu COB. Quick Q — who does press helpline first 2 hours? PR or Partnerships?
nina: PR will handle press queries. Partnerships to triage SI/partner technical asks. I’ll own PR helpline rota 07:30-11:00 PT.
sam: Noted. Next steps: 1) mira to push runbook v0.2 by Thu AM 2) jon to deliver final landing assets Thu COB 3) lee to confirm dry-run Wed and provide staging creds 4) nina to publish PR helpline rota.
mira: Thanks — I’ll send runbook v0.2 by Thu 09:00 PT and add a short checklist for ops and support. If anyone needs to be looped into dry-run, ping here and I’ll add calendar invite.
lee: Adding staging slot: Wed 14:00 PT for dry-run. Invite sent.
jon: Got it, will be there with final assets.
nina: All good on PR side. Please include one-pager for spokes in the runbook (key messages + embargo FAQs).
mira: Will add one-pager. If no blockers by EOD tomorrow, consider this lane green. :white_check_mark:
